name: How long does a hail damage roof repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a hail damage roof repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of hail damage repair depends on the extent of the damage, the size of your roof, and material availability. Minor repairs might take a day, while a full roof replacement can take several days to a week. Weather conditions can also affect the timeline, as roofing work requires dry conditions. Your contractor should provide an estimated timeframe.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies by damage extent, roof size, and weather; minor repairs take a day, full replacements several days.
